name: Visual Genome
description: Visual Genome is a dataset, a knowledge base, an ongoing effort to connect structured image concepts to language. The dataset contains over 108K images where each image has an average of 35 objects, 26 attributes, and 21 pairwise relationships between objects. It includes 5.4 Million Region Descriptions, 1.7 Million Visual Question Answers, 3.8 Million Object Instances, 2.8 Million Attributes, and 2.3 Million Relationships. The dataset canonicalizes objects, attributes, relationships, and noun phrases in region descriptions and questions answer pairs to WordNet synsets.

rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected over the course of 6 months after 15 months of experimentation and iteration on the data representation. Approximately 800,000 Human Intelligence Tasks (HITs) were launched on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT), where each HIT involved creating descriptions, questions and answers, or region graphs.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) was used as the primary source of annotations. Each HIT was designed such that workers manage to earn anywhere between $6-$8 per hour if they work continuously, in line with ethical research standards on Mechanical Turk. Visual Genome HITs achieved a 94.1% retention rate, meaning that 94.1% of workers who completed one of our tasks went ahead to do more.
rai:annotatorDemographics: A total of over 33,000 unique workers contributed to the dataset. 93.02% of workers contributed from the United States. The majority of workers were between the ages of 25 and 34 years old. The youngest contributor was 18 years and the oldest was 68 years old. There was a near-balanced split of 54.15% male and 45.85% female workers.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Age, gender, and geography (United States) of annotators.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset supports tasks including image-to-text, object-detection, visual-question-answering, and image-captioning. It is designed for cognitive tasks that involve not just recognizing, but reasoning about the visual world, such as image description and question answering.
